 Our Tip of the Day looks to make it three-in-a-row as focus turns to Indian Wells
 The Tip of the Day is on a roll. Today, we head to the WTA Finals for our predictions
 Jon Fisher 
 • 
 Last Update:
 21 hours ago
 • 
 2 min read
 Tuesday’s Tip of the Day was another success, backing up Monday’s win! Let’s try and keep it rolling on Wednesday.
 We’re sticking with tennis following yesterday’s winning leg and heading off to the WTA Finals in Indian Wells.
 There are two games scheduled for today with Aryna Sabalenka facing Mirra Andreeva and, first up, Elina Svitolina taking on Karolina Muchova.
 Sabalenka is the highest-ranked player in the event following the withdrawal of world number one Elena Rybakina. The second seed won’t have it all her own way against Andreeva, who is ranked just one place lower, but we fancy the Belarusian, who has a 4-2 head-to-head record against the 19-year-old.
 Andreeva won the last meeting, ironically at Indian Wells, and Sabalenka will be gunning for revenge.
 The second match, between Svitolina and Muchova, ought to be a tight affair. Both ladies lost their opening Group 2 outings and know there is little room for error.
 Svitolina has a 3-1 record against the Czech but Muchova won their last meeting on clay in Stuttgart. The last two matches between the pair have gone the distance and with similar game-styles, there seems little to separate them here.
 Wednesday’s Tip of the Day (all odds are from  bet365  and correct as of 1300 on Wednesday, November 11) 
 Aryna Sabalenka to beat Mirra Andreeva @ 10/11 
 Elina Svitolina v Karolina Muchova – 3 sets @ 6/5 
 Combined odds of 3.2/1
